name: Colossus 2

timeline.event: Land clearing begins next to the existing building.

Battery facility connected to the building. 121 air-cooled chillers installed, which could support 200 MW. In the Duke faciltiy in nearby Mississippi, several natural gas turbines are in place but not fully connected up.

explain: Colossus 2 is an operating AI data center in Memphis, TN, owned by xai and used by anthropic, anysphere. Epoch AI estimates it draws 946 MW today and 2,065 MW when finished.
